role: machine-readable full-production-app instructions for GitHub-connected coding agents; navigation/policy only
goal: Build and improve the complete full-featured production-grade CACE mathematics and sciences playground so it just works for ordinary supported users while preserving canonical scientific/proof/security semantics.

build_optimizer.purpose: minimize redundant build/test work using deterministic DAG/critical-path/cache/resource mathematics
build_optimizer.authority: coordination only; no scientific or proof authority

production_requirements: retain canonical Python graph/module/evidence core
retain pinned Lean formal source and qualification architecture
browser/mobile/generated UI calls typed backend APIs instead of recreating scientific semantics
implement durable account/session/storage/network surfaces behind authenticated server boundaries
keep AI optional and outside verification authority
keep wallet/exchange private keys outside AI/model context
preserve PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN/stale semantics
run appropriate regression/security/proof gates before production-ready claims
attempt every required production feature; do not silently omit unknown/difficult features
preserve all established CACE architectures/invariants unless an explicit reviewed migration supersedes one
for an implementation the builder does not know, generate and rank 10 candidate approaches, then use CACE Build Lite/existing CACE tools to select the safest viable approach
when a missing capability is required, build a narrow tested helper tool rather than weakening an existing architecture
apply the CACE bug-flush sibling sweep and permanent-regression-guard loop to every confirmed defect
the webapp/gateway is the only client-visible surface; all privileged CACE services remain private/local behind typed server-side mediation
generated browser code must never connect directly to local AI/model servers, databases, wallet RPC, filesystem workers, scientific/native workers, network-pairing transport, or the Lean runner
deliver a full-featured production-grade mathematics and sciences playground that just works rather than a demo or simplified substitute
startup self-checks and self-sandboxes the private/local service plane with safe defaults and visible graceful degradation
free trial requires no credit card and is granted once per verified person identity anchor; new/deleted accounts cannot reset the trial
post-trial limited mode is non-destructive and always preserves reasonable view/export/delete/recovery access to user-owned data
generate customer-safe help from the live registry so every registered module has at least two direct and two combined examples without exposing proprietary implementation or custom mathematics
hosted_builder_rules: do not output only a prototype when repository requirements call for a full production app
do not remove or bypass tests/guardrails to simplify generation
do not weaken proof claims, negative tests, or evidence boundaries
do not put secrets in generated client code or repository files
write reviewed changes back to GitHub so another agent can continue
use CACE Build Lite before broad expensive builds

base44.instruction: Use the repository as authoritative source; map generated auth/data/functions/UI to CACE typed API and account contracts, then commit/sync reviewed changes back to GitHub.

gemini_ai_studio.instruction: Import/open the repository, preserve the canonical backend/formal boundaries, use Build Lite JSON to choose build/test frontier, and sync reviewed source changes back to GitHub.

generic.instruction: Read the required files and use the same production/security/proof contracts.

payment_policy.instruction: Use the existing canonical CACE Monero receive wallet. Do not generate, substitute, or silently migrate to a new Monero wallet/address.
payment_policy.secrets_rule: Public receive address may be configured in source; private keys/seeds/view keys/wallet-RPC credentials/exchange credentials must remain outside repository/client/model context.
payment_policy.math_coin_rule: The local-AI Math Coin wallet is separate from the Monero receive wallet.

use_cace_first: CACE Build Lite dependency and critical-path planning
existing typed modules and scientific/runtime contracts
unknown_feature_protocol.custom_tool_rule: If no existing tool is sufficient, build the smallest typed deterministic helper with tests and least privilege; do not create a second competing architecture.
unknown_feature_protocol.failure_rule: If no safe viable approach exists, preserve all ranked approaches plus blockers and leave the feature visibly incomplete; never fake completion.

architecture_preservation.rule: All established CACE architectures are cumulative constraints until explicitly superseded by an approved migration.
required_preservations: backwards-compatible public schemas or explicit migrations

deployment_boundary.client_rule: Browser/client communicates only with the same-origin HTTPS/WSS web gateway.
deployment_boundary.private_layer: orchestrator, scientific runtime, AI broker, databases, pairing/economy/payment brokers, native workers, durable storage and proof runner
deployment_boundary.builder_rule: Base44/Gemini/generated frontend may implement presentation/gateway integration but must preserve the hardened private layer and canonical backend semantics.

product_experience.target: full-featured production-grade mathematics and sciences playground that just works
product_experience.startup_rule: preflight, initialize safe local state, start hardened private services, expose only gateway, detect optional backends, degrade visibly

trial_account_policy.duplicate_action: account recovery/merge, not a new trial
trial_account_policy.expiry: non-destructive limited mode; preserve view/export/delete/recovery/help/license management

public_help_policy.minimum_examples: 2 direct + 2 combined per module; 2 per feature
public_help_policy.secrecy: public behavior/contracts/evidence only; no proprietary equations, derivations, algorithms, hidden defaults, theorem bodies, source internals or credentials
